description: This file defines the 'Returns' class within the Opencart admin controller namespace for handling email notifications related to product returns. It extends the base Controller class and contains a method 'index' that constructs and sends email notifications about return statuses to customers.

classes.name: Returns
classes.description: Controller class responsible for sending email notifications about return statuses within the admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Builds and sends a return notification email based on provided route parameters: return ID, status ID, comment, and notification flag.
